editorial:
Imagine being a tiny kid with a giant brain, stuck with parents who do not care about you and a principal who is basically a nightmare. That is exactly what you get with this colorful and loud musical. You will meet Matilda, a brilliant girl who loves books and discovers she can move things with her mind. The movie feels like a big party on screen, filled with catchy songs and bright colors that make the world feel magical. It is a sweet story about finding your own strength and standing up to bullies, and it keeps a light, happy energy from start to finish.

You will love the acting, especially the kids who bring so much heart to their roles. The music is the best part, as it really drives the story forward without feeling too slow. While some of the adult characters are a bit over the top, it fits the funny, cartoonish style of the film. If you want a cozy night in, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors, or maybe rent it on Apple TV. It is a perfect pick for a family movie night that will leave you feeling good.
endingExplained: After using her powers to scare the mean Principal Trunchbull away for good, Matilda helps her teacher, Miss Honey, get her house and life back. Matilda's parents decide to run away to avoid the police, but they agree to let Miss Honey adopt Matilda. You get a happy ending where Matilda finally has a loving home and a family that actually appreciates how smart and special she is.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical stories and catchy songs
